---
name: speckit-tasks
description: Derive an actionable, dependency-aware task list from approved design documents.
---

Read `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and all design artifacts. Replace template examples with concrete tasks using exact repository paths. Group tasks by independently deliverable user story, include tests when required by the specification, mark only genuinely parallel tasks with `[P]`, and create or update `specs/<feature>/tasks.md`.
